rust_summary:
a mob walked with the engine's pathfinding and turned to look, as vanilla's goals drive it (`native_mob_navigate`,
`native_mob_follow`, `native_mob_stop`, `native_mob_navigating`, `native_mob_look_at`).
doc_summary: a mob of any loaded level driven as vanilla's goals drive it: `native_mob_navigate(dimension, mob, to, reach, speed)` (`PathNavigation.moveTo` to a point, round walls), `native_mob_follow(dimension, mob, target, speed)` (`moveTo` an entity, a player too), `native_mob_stop(dimension, mob)`, `native_mob_navigating(dimension, mob)` (`isInProgress`) and `native_mob_look_at(dimension, mob, at)` (`LookControl.setLookAt`). Bundles need "hooks": @API:npc_mob_navigation@.
